registry: paper_trading/strategies.json — versioned paper strategy cards (append-only by policy)
law: new idea = new version; constants never tuned after results are seen; PT results are NOT evidence for H14-H20

strategies.hypothesis: Transparent naive baseline: young + liquid-enough + non-vetoed tokens. TRUTH BASELINE for cost/liquidity reality. NO profitability claim.
strategies.sample_size: descriptive; >=30 closed trades before expectancy language
strategies.failure_criteria: net expectancy <= 0 over >=30 closed trades => stands as negative evidence
strategies.success_criteria: descriptive only; promotion requires an independent validation protocol (none exists yet)

strategies.hypothesis: 24h realistic experiment: $20.00 virtual bankroll + transparent gates + scam/rug defense. Question: what would ACTUALLY happen to the $20? No edge claim; shrinkage is valid evidence.

entry.evm_requires: is_honeypot FALSE AND sell_tax_extreme FALSE resolved
entry.security: multi-signal: rugcheck(SOL) | goplus(EVM) + LP-age rule; UNKNOWN never PASS

strategies.data_window: 24h live experiment from 2026-08-12 (cycles on demand / scheduled sessions)
strategies.sample_size: whatever 24h honestly yields — no forced trades
strategies.failure_criteria: bankroll decline / trapped capital / zero qualifiers = publishable outcomes
strategies.success_criteria: answers to directive O questions; >=30 closed trades before any expectancy language

strategies.hypothesis: Realizable-value truth model (wave-8 continuation directive 2/3/7): displayed token value is NOT money. Every open position is priced through an exitability gate: executable-notional cap (impact <= 1500bps, same linear liquidity model as PT-COST-v1) minus slip/fee/sell-tax(provider-resolved only)/gas(MODEL constant). Locked BEFORE results.

constants.gas_provenance: MODEL constant 2026-08-12 (no live gas oracle in lab) — honest tag, not live data
constants.deduction_order: slip -> fee(100bps on post-slip) -> sell_tax (KNOWN only, else NULL) -> gas

strategies.failure_criteria: if realized exits systematically beat model realizable values, the model stands as documented conservative evidence (no silent tuning)
strategies.success_criteria: every position report carries displayed AND realizable; trapped capital recognized at <=10% recovery

strategies.hypothesis: Autonomous exit decision engine (wave-8 continuation directive 1/5/6/7/8/12): manage every open position on CURRENT evidence each cycle. Inherits PT-X2-v2 (=> PT-X1-v1 thresholds) and ADDS exitability-first pricing, partial exits, and profit-lock rules that bank REALIZABLE value. Probability fields are recorded as NOT_ESTIMABLE (frozen no-probability law); all factors categorical. Effective FORWARD-ONLY for all open v2 positions from creation time (owner-mandated upgrade; prior X2 decisions unmodified, append-only).
priority_order: TRAPPED/TOTAL_LOSS on realizable < 10% of allocated (after ALL costs incl. gas)
RISK_EXIT on post-entry security flip while still sellable
inherited triggers: LIQUIDITY_COLLAPSE(2x<$2000) / SL-35% / TP+50% / TIME 48h / INVALID stale
EXIT_RISK on escalation (liq -50% vs entry, price x2 while liq halves)
DIVERGENCE_PROFIT_LOCK: displayed >=3x alloc AND realizable >=2x alloc => bank the real
DECAY_PROFIT_LOCK: realizable >=1.5x alloc AND price <=85% of monitor peak (>=2 obs)
strategies.partial_exit_rule: chunk = min(displayed, executable_notional_cap); if leftover < $0.25 => merge to FULL; proportional allocated basis retired per chunk
strategies.failure_criteria: profit-lock rules that destroy realized value across >=10 closed trades become documented negative evidence (rules NOT silently retuned)
strategies.success_criteria: positions close on evidence; zero mark-price-fiction claims; every close yields a lesson

strategies.hypothesis: R-C3 closure card (owner-authorized versioned fix): PT-X3-v1 thresholds and branch order UNCHANGED; the only addition is the structural stale-observation law. Trigger: R-29 anomaly — the 2026-08-13 00:55Z pass decided on obs aged 16.2-17.65h; zero contamination occurred, but the trapped/divergence/decay branches lacked an obs-age gate. This card closes the hole before it can fire.
strategies.law: obs age > 21600s (inherited PT-X1-v1 exit_reference_max_age_sec, referenced not duplicated) at decision time => market-price-derived exit/settlement/realizable-realization FORBIDDEN. Convert to NO_DATA (STALE_OBSERVATION; nothing priced, monitoring continues) or INVALID (a base trigger fired but is unpriceable — inherited INVALID_DATA_UNAVAILABLE path). Price-INDEPENDENT closes remain allowed: CONFIRMED_HONEYPOT / CONFIRMED_UNEXITSABLE => TOTAL_LOSS with recoverable 0 by contract evidence; exit_price_observed stored NULL (never a stale price in the ledger). belt-and-suspenders: _settle() independently refuses stale-priced settlement.
strategies.regression_evidence: tests/test_paper_trading_v32.py (6h+1s and 16h fault injection, boundary 21600/21601, recovery-after-stale, immutability pins)
strategies.failure_criteria: if any stale observation is ever found in a settled exit row's pricing path, this card has failed and the evidence stands (append-only)
strategies.success_criteria: from activation forward: zero settled exits priced on obs older than 6h; v1 history rows untouched and queryable under PT-X3-v1
